summary: ALCS Game 4 in Cleveland, Guardians up 2-1: Nick Martinez (3.10 ERA, 17 outs a start this season) for Tampa Bay, and reliever Shawn Armstrong opens a Cleveland bullpen game. The total has moved toward the Over. Lineups are posted; 59 degrees and cloudy.

legs.note: Every game in this series has been decided by 4 runs or fewer and two by 1 or 2, and Cleveland is at home. Getting a run and a half in a tight, low-scoring series covers most outcomes.
Games 2 and 3 produced 4 and 5 runs, but a Cleveland bullpen game and an Over-leaning market make this close to a coin flip.

extra_legs.note: Martinez allows about 7 hits per 9 innings (1.09 WHIP), and the market expects about 12 outs from him. That projects around 3 hits, so he needs a bad night to allow 4.
extra_legs.status: Confirmed starter; took a liner off the back in the ALDS clincher, no injury since

extra_legs.note: Martinez averaged 17 outs on 81 pitches across 31 starts this season, and four full innings is a low bar. His two short outings came when he was hit hard and when a line drive struck him.
